server.buildCommand: echo "== pulse: checking DB env" && node -e "const u=process.env.DATABASE_URL||''; if(!u){console.error('== DATABASE_URL is missing in this build');process.exit(1)} const c=u.charCodeAt(0); if(c===34||c===39){console.error('== DATABASE_URL starts with a quote. Remove the quotes.');process.exit(1)} console.log('== DB url length:', u.length, '| prefix:', u.slice(0,11))" && echo "== pulse: generate" && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && echo "== pulse: db push" && npx prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma --skip-generate && echo "== pulse: seed" && node prisma/seed.mjs
